claim: Credit a catch-up gap by line count only when the gap is under a frame and end it before any longer stretch; run the catch-up clock low, since a gap's real gain differs by clock.

evidence.text: Credit by line count only over gaps under a frame, ended before any longer stretch; catch-up credits the gap x 2 at 7 MHz.
At 28 MHz a gap's real gain runs 3 to 8 times its lines (hooks against contended writes); at 7 MHz near 2 whatever the gap holds.
